newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor, Cerestar to set starch syrup j/v.
newsitem.headline: Cultor, Cerestar to set starch syrup j/v.

text.p: Finnish food and sweetener group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Thursday it agreed with Cerestar Scandinavia A/S to set up a joint starch syrup marketing company with annual sales of 50 million markka.
"In addition to Finland the company will extend its market to cover northwestern Russia as a new area," Cultor said.
Its product range would comprise starch syrup from Cultor's Neson Oy and starch syrup and dextrose from Cerestar, it said.
Cultor said volumes are a major factor for price competitiveness in starch syrups and that Neson's capacity was very small compared to other companies in the EU.
Cerestar is a Belgium based subsidiary of French Eridania Beghin-Say and it has 15 plants, making basic starch and processed starches for food and industry use, Cultor said.
